mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and increased discount rates, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in two months signals a decline in demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST decreases by more than 10%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in two months signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three months signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where RSAFS shows sustained growth.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2%, it signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a low-growth environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) combined with an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals deflationary pressure with strong labor demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: deflationary pressure with strong labor demand
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where both conditions are met.
